title: First-class assertion-only HTML profiles with an explicit evidence floor
objective: Make the extraction matrix OPTIONAL by adding a first-class assertion-only profile mode, so a profile whose official page states its terms entirely in prose extracts from that page as it actually exists, and migrate the two GitHub profiles whose live pages contain zero <table> elements off the fabricated one-cell anchor table. Because the mandatory matrix today doubles as an accidental evidence floor, replace it with an EXPLICIT per-mode floor so relaxing the matrix requirement never makes a candidate backed by no evidence possible.
measured_premise: P1 MEASURED 2026-08-14: the live github-pages-limits page returns HTTP 200 and contains ZERO <table> elements.
P2 MEASURED 2026-08-14: the live enterprise-cloud-trial page returns HTTP 200 and contains ZERO <table> elements.
P3 MEASURED 2026-08-14: driving HtmlDocAdapter.extract over the LIVE markup, github_pages_limits and github_enterprise_cloud_trial both return the rejected candidate table_not_found.

P4 POSITIVE CONTROL MEASURED 2026-08-14: the live about-billing-for-github-actions page has 4 <table> elements and github_actions_billing extracts 10 facts with 10 evidence locations and zero validation problems from that live markup, so the probe harness is not vacuous.
in_scope: apps/api/app/ingest/adapters/html.py (the engine; normally protected, this slice owns it)
tests/fixtures/ingest/github/html/github-pages-limits/** (delete the fabricated anchor table; update capture.json and expected.json)
out_of_scope_zero_diff: apps/api/app/ingest/fetch.py and tests/unit/test_ingest_fetch.py (a concurrent security slice owns these)
agent-state/feature_list.json (byte-identical to base; F008 stays passes:false)
any manifest, lockfile, override, or audit configuration
promotion or merge of the draft pull request
acceptance_criteria: A1: A profile with mode='assertions' extracts successfully from a document containing NO tables, producing facts and per-fact evidence entirely from pinned HtmlTextAssertion blocks.

A2: THE CENTRAL GUARD. A profile that declares no fact source is REJECTED fail-closed, as an explicit per-mode decision rather than a fall-through. The floor is mode-aware: rows mode requires columns or assertions, matrix mode requires matrix_rows, assertions mode requires assertions. A profile declaring neither a matrix nor any assertions cannot be constructed at all.
A3: An assertion-only profile must not declare any table selector, columns, or matrix_rows; declaring one is a construction-time ValueError, so 'assertion-only' cannot quietly become 'table-backed'.
A4: A runtime evidence floor also holds: an assertion-only extraction that yields zero evidence rejects explicitly rather than emitting an empty candidate.
A5: github_pages_limits and github_enterprise_cloud_trial no longer return table_not_found against their LIVE pages, re-measured with the same probe that established P3.
A6: The fabricated <table id="captured-source-anchor"> is DELETED from both fixtures, and each capture.json discloses the new reality without claiming an anchor table that no longer exists.

A7: Every listed existing control still goes RED when its underlying behaviour is broken: unknown_matrix_rows, missing_matrix_rows, duplicate_matrix_rows, irregular_row_width, ambiguous_table, assertion_not_found (deleted, reworded, truncated, appended-clause), ambiguous_assertion, and __post_init__ closed-vocabulary validation. Each is proved by mutation and restored BYTE-EXACTLY, proved by blob hash (git hash-object vs git rev-parse ref:path), never numstat.
A8: Test counts do not fall from the measured baseline.
A9: Classifier behaviour is unchanged: the four perpetual GitHub allowances stay Z0_TRUE_FREE, the trial stays Z2_TEMPORARY_OR_CONDITIONAL, and Z0 stays unreachable wherever card status is unknown.
A10: The full suite and scripts/check.ps1 -NodeAudit pass, except the accepted, documented Dependency audit failure on GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8 which also fails on untouched base.
A11: The diff is limited to approved files, protected state is byte-identical, and the pull request remains DRAFT.
verification_plan: Re-derive origin/main with git ls-remote before branching and again immediately before reporting.
Measure the test baseline on the untouched base tree and record it.
Fetch both live pages, count <table> elements, and drive the real engine over the live bytes BEFORE and AFTER the change.
Run every mutation control, confirm RED, restore, and prove restoration by blob hash.
Run the full suite and scripts/check.ps1 -NodeAudit.
Verify protected blobs with git rev-parse and git diff --stat run UNFILTERED first as a positive control.
Open a draft PR and inspect its state with gh pr view.
negative_tests: A profile declaring neither matrix nor assertions must raise at construction, not emit a candidate.
An assertion-only profile that also declares a table selector or columns must raise, so it cannot silently regain a synthetic anchor.
An assertion-only profile whose optional assertions all miss must reject with an explicit no-evidence error rather than emit an empty candidate.
Making the matrix optional must not let a matrix-mode profile drop its matrix_rows requirement.
The migrated profiles must still reject when any pinned sentence is deleted, reworded, truncated, or given an appended clause.
data_implications: No migration, no CHECK constraint, no persisted schema change. Two committed fixture documents lose a fabricated table that never existed on the live page; the published FACTS of both offers are unchanged, because the anchor table mapped no column and therefore carried no claim.
security_privacy: No network, credential, dependency, or fetch-policy change. apps/api/app/ingest/fetch.py is untouched. Live pages were read read-only over HTTPS from already-allowlisted docs.github.com.
portability: Standard library only; no new dependency and no platform-specific behaviour.
z0_risk: The dominant risk of this slice is that relaxing the mandatory matrix removes the accidental evidence floor and allows a candidate backed by nothing, which in this product means potentially publishing an unsupported claim that a service is free. A2 and A4 exist specifically to convert that accidental floor into an explicit, tested one. Classifier behaviour is unchanged and the trial remains non-Z0.
